prompt: Cleanup preview reports the expected two detachments and two deletions, but execution sometimes fails with a resource still referenced or assigned error. Operations in each phase may run in any order; phases complete in sequence. Diagnose and fix cleanup.py with the smallest change that completes all four operations and preserves unrelated resources. The local reproduction command is python3 check_cleanup.py. Do not change the supplied checker. Use only this anonymous local fixture, without network or dependencies.

evaluation.scope: Deterministic enumeration of parallel operation orders catches a correct-diff cleanup with unsafe reference/deletion ordering. Synthetic in-memory resources only; no network, credentials, clock, external SDK, or project data.

rubric.criterion: Run a red-capable reproduction that catches unsafe execution order rather than accepting correct action counts.
Detach every reference before its resource can be deleted, while retaining all cleanup actions and unrelated resources.
